title: Remote digest duplicate check is not atomic

evidence.quote:
val digestEntity = DigestEntity(
            generatedAt = generatedAt,
            epubFilePath = epubFilePath,
            articleCount = articleCount,
            briefingCount = briefingCount,
            fidelityCount = fidelityCount,
            triggerType = triggerType,
            feedNames = feedNames.joinToString(","),
            remoteId = remoteId,
            period = period,
            isComplete = true,
            errorMessage = null
        )

        val digestId = if (articles != null && articles.isNotEmpty()) {
            // Convert articles and insert with digest
            val articleEntities = articles.map { article ->
                DigestArticleEntity(
                    digestId = 0, // Will be set by transaction
                    title = article.title,
                    author = article.author ?: "",
                    content = article.contentHtml?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: article.content,
                    originalUrl = article.url,
                    isSummary = article.mode == "summarize" || article.mode == "summarized",
                    feedName = article.feedTitle,
                    sortOrder = article.sortOrder
                )
            }
            digestDao.insertDigestWithArticles(digestEntity, articleEntities)
        } else {
            // No articles - insert digest only (backwards compatibility)
            digestDao.insertDigest(digestEntity)
        }

reasoning: The method checks for an existing remoteId before inserting, but the check and insert are separate repository operations. Concurrent sync paths can both observe that the remote digest is absent and then both insert it, creating duplicate local digest rows for the same backend digest.
reproduction: Run two saveRemoteDigest calls concurrently with the same remoteId against an empty database; both can pass the existsByRemoteId check before either insert commits.
recommendation: Move remoteId idempotency into the database boundary with a unique remoteId constraint and conflict-ignore/upsert insert, or wrap the check-and-insert in a single DAO transaction that enforces uniqueness.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests exercise concurrent saveRemoteDigest calls or duplicate remote IDs.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a coroutine test that launches two saveRemoteDigest calls with the same remoteId and asserts only one local digest is created.
minimumFixScope: DigestRepository.saveRemoteDigest and the digest DAO/entity insert contract for remoteId uniqueness.
